name: llm-accuracy
description: One verification workflow for accurate first outputs and checking existing answers, plus clarification and local diagnostics.

python_executable.title: Python executable (optional)
python_executable.description: Leave empty for automatic Python 3.9+ discovery. Set an executable name or absolute path, without arguments, only to override discovery. No Git Bash required on Windows.

claim_fidelity_mode.title: Claim fidelity reminder mode (optional)
claim_fidelity_mode.description: Leave empty for session: the evidence reminder once per session start, resume, clear and compaction, plus a short clarification check on each prompt and targeted evidence guidance. general: the reminder on every prompt. targeted: matching prompts only. The CC_CLAIM_FIDELITY_MODE environment variable overrides this.
